commit.message:
Feed the PRs screen from prs.rs and show transcript tails in the Agents detail

LiveSource now fetches open PRs through gh on a background thread every
60 s (the first snapshot waits at most 1.5 s so one-shot frames carry
real counts), maps them to the PRs screen with the exact missing merge
preconditions, and marks rows stale with the time of the last good
fetch when gh fails. Each agent's detail pane gets the last 40 messages
of its transcript (Claude, Codex, Cursor and Grok line shapes; role:
text, sanitized, 200 chars), read from the file tail and cached by
mtime and length under a 60 ms per-snapshot budget.

Plan of record PR 7/8 wiring completion (MVP definition §3).
